summary: 71-year-old man collapsed in the Cliff Palace parking lot; two teenage visitors with CPR training began resuscitation, park medic and rangers continued care with an AED (four shocks) and medications, and his pulse returned; transported by Tri-State Care Flight helicopter to an ICU.
location: Cliff Palace parking lot, Mesa Verde National Park
responding_agency: NPS Mesa Verde rangers and park medic; Tri-State Care Flight
notes: NPS morning-report compendium entry reported 2013-08-02 (Saturday-verified 2013-07-27); survived; flight nurse credited the response with saving his life.
